title: Household Energy Consumption by Source in Four Countries (2022)
prompt: The pie chart below shows the percentage breakdown of household energy consumption by source in four countries (A, B, C, and D) in 2022. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先仔细阅读饼图，注意四个国家在能源结构上的主要差异与相似之处。写作时，先概述总体特征（如哪些能源占主导、哪些国家依赖化石燃料较多），再通过比较具体数据展开论述。确保使用准确的百分比表达和比较结构，并达到至少150词。
